subject.title: Feature: allow account switching from /models buttons for GPT and Claude

question: Should `/models` become a first-class model-and-account picker for provider-backed models, and should that contract be shared across Discord, Telegram, and future channel pickers?
rationale: Current code deliberately separates model selection from auth-profile state, and changing that affects cross-channel UX, provider routing, session persistence, and upgrade compatibility.

options.title: Define shared picker support
options.body: Add a shared account/profile selection contract to the model picker and implement it in supported channels with compatibility tests.

options.title: Keep typed profile pinning
options.body: Keep `/model ...@profile`, `/model status`, and auth-order commands as the supported account-switching path and document that `/models` remains model-only.

options.title: Pilot one channel first
options.body: Approve a narrower Discord or Telegram experiment before promoting the account-picker state to the shared contract.

recommendation.title: Define shared picker support
recommendation.body: Add a shared account/profile selection contract to the model picker and implement it in supported channels with compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points to steipete for adjacent model/auth override behavior and auth-profile documentation, and the decision is primarily about product semantics for that state.
